name: qoe-web-player
description: Web video player with QoE metrics collection

scripts.test:allure: vitest run --run && mkdir -p allure-results/unit && cp test-results/vitest-junit.xml allure-results/unit/TEST-vitest.xml
scripts.e2e:bat: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=bat playwright test --project=chromium --grep @BAT
scripts.e2e:smoke: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=smoke playwright test --project=chromium --grep @Smoke
scripts.e2e:regression: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=regression playwright test --project=chromium --grep @Regression
scripts.e2e:docker: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=e2e playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:bat:headed: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=bat playwright test --project=chromium --grep @BAT --headed
scripts.e2e:smoke:headed: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=smoke playwright test --project=chromium --grep @Smoke --headed
scripts.e2e:regression:headed: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=regression playwright test --project=chromium --grep @Regression --headed
scripts.e2e:docker:headed: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_STAGE=e2e playwright test --project=chromium --headed
scripts.report:bat: npm run e2e:bat && npm run allure:bat
scripts.report:smoke: npm run e2e:smoke && npm run allure:smoke
scripts.report:regression: npm run e2e:regression && npm run allure:regression
